injury_reports.name: Jahan Dotson
injury_reports.summary: Dotson caught two of four passes for 54 yards during the Falcons' 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Drake London
injury_reports.summary: London caught seven of 11 targets for 118 yards in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Jake Matthews
injury_reports.summary: Matthews (groin) is active for Sunday night's game against the Ravens, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Ethan Onianwa
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Michael Penix Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Penix (ribs) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game against the Bears, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Pitts caught five of six targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Bijan Robinson
injury_reports.summary: Robinson rushed 17 times for 86 yards while catching four of seven targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Robinson handled seven carries for 16 yards and did not catch his only target during Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss versus the Ravens. He also returned two kickoffs for 61 return yards.

injury_reports.name: Cooper Rush
injury_reports.summary: Rush (coach's decision) is listed as inactive but will serve as the Falcons' emergency third quarterback for Sunday's game against the Bears.

injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Tua Tagovailoa
injury_reports.summary: With Michael Penix (ribs) cleared to play Sunday against the Bears, Tagovailoa will handle backup duties for the Falcons.

injury_reports.summary: The Falcons placed Abdullah (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday, Tori McElhaney of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.summary: Smith (neck) is active for Sunday's game against the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Nick Folk
injury_reports.summary: Folk converted all five of his kicks (three field goals, two extra points) during Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Jermaine Eluemunor
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Malachi Fields
injury_reports.summary: Fields hauled in both of his targets for 20 yards during the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Commanders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jake Haener
injury_reports.summary: Haener is inactive for Sunday's game against the Saints but is listed as the Giants' emergency quarterback, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Najee Harris
injury_reports.summary: Harris is expected to serve as the Giants' starting running back in Sunday's game against the Saints, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Theo Johnson
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Likely
injury_reports.summary: Likely caught 11 of 13 targets for 94 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Commanders.

injury_reports.name: J.J. McCarthy
injury_reports.summary: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Wednesday he plans to keep using McCarthy in a change-of-pace role behind starting quarterback Jameis Winston in an effort to take advantage of McCarthy's scrambling ability, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Darnell Mooney
injury_reports.summary: Mooney (neck) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Cam Skattebo
injury_reports.summary: Skattebo had a "pretty even split in reps" this week with fellow running back Najee Harris and could be in store for fewer snaps and touches than usual in Sunday's game against the Saints, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Thomas
injury_reports.summary: Thomas (groin), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, is expected to play, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Tracy is expected to continue serving as the Giants' primary third-down back in Sunday's game against the Saints, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Abdul Carter
injury_reports.summary: Carter (calf) is active for Sunday's game against the Saints, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Colton Hood
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Tyler Nubin
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: CJ Okoye
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Dru Phillips
injury_reports.summary: Phillips had five total tackles (five solo) and 2.0 sacks in Sunday's 27-27 tie with the Commanders.

injury_reports.name: Jason Pinnock
injury_reports.summary: Pinnock (concussion) doesn't carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Dominic Zvada
injury_reports.summary: Zvada went 2-for-5 on field-goal attempts and made all three of his extra-point tries during Sunday's 27-27 tie with the Commanders.

injury_reports.name: Braxton Berrios
injury_reports.summary: Berrios (foot) underwent successful surgery Friday to repair a Lisfranc injury, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Davante Adams
injury_reports.summary: Adams brought in five of seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Davis Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen (foot) does not have an injury designation against the Cardinals on Sunday, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Corum
injury_reports.summary: Corum rushed five times for 19 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 53 yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Higbee
injury_reports.summary: Higbee brought in five of six targets for 83 yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Alaric Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson's suspension for an act of unsportsmanlike conduct during Monday's game versus the Bills has been reduced to one game, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: Puka Nacua
injury_reports.summary: Nacua brought in 17 of 24 targets for 138 yards and a touchdown and rushed twice for nine yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Colby Parkinson
injury_reports.summary: Parkinson (shoulder) doesn't carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Ty Simpson
injury_reports.summary: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Monday, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Matthew Stafford
injury_reports.summary: Stafford completed 40 of 54 passes for 383 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Keagen Trost
injury_reports.summary: The Rams activated Trost (hamstring) from injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Kyren Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams rushed 16 times for 49 yards and a touchdown and brought in six of eight targets for 27 yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Kam Curl
injury_reports.summary: Curl (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Quentin Lake
injury_reports.summary: Lake (hip) is active for Monday's game against the Bills, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Nate Landman
injury_reports.summary: Landman (wrist/shoulder) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Trent McDuffie
injury_reports.summary: McDuffie (groin) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Watson
injury_reports.summary: Watson (shoulder) does not have an injury designation for Monday's game against the Bills, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Grupe
injury_reports.summary: The Rams signed Grupe off the Jets' practice squad Tuesday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Myles Garrett
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Sean McVay told reporters Tuesday that Garrett (knee) will not return to practice this week and will not play against the Cardinals on Sunday, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Allgeier
injury_reports.summary: Allgeier is poised for a leading role out of the Cardinals backfield Sunday at the Rams with Jeremiyah Love (ankle) sidelined in Week 6, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Carson Beck
injury_reports.summary: Beck (coach's decision) is inactive and is designated as Arizona's emergency third quarterback for Sunday's matchup versus the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Kendrick Bourne
injury_reports.summary: Bourne caught five of eight targets for 70 yards during Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Shawn Bowman
injury_reports.summary: Bowman was signed from the practice squad to the active roster Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Jacoby Brissett
injury_reports.summary: Brissett completed 29 of 47 passes for 292 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding two rushes for 19 yards and a seven-yard reception on his only target in the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Brooks
injury_reports.summary: Brooks recorded two catches for 16 yards on seven targets in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Evan Hull
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals elevated Hull from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Bam Knight
injury_reports.summary: Knight will bump up the Cardinals' RB depth chart in Week 6 with Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled out, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jeremiyah Love
injury_reports.summary: Love (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Trey McBride
injury_reports.summary: McBride brought in nine of 10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Teagan Quitoriano
injury_reports.summary: Quitoriano caught both of his targets for 15 yards and two touchdowns during Sunday's 45-21 loss to Detroit.

injury_reports.name: Reggie Virgil
injury_reports.summary: Virgil recorded two receptions for 29 yards on five targets in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Michael Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson brought in four of seven targets for 30 yards and completed his only pass attempt for seven yards in the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Budda Baker
injury_reports.summary: Baker (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Zaven Collins
injury_reports.summary: Collins (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Kitan Crawford
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals activated Crawford (ankle) from injured reserve Saturday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Walter Nolen III
injury_reports.summary: Nolen (calf) is active for Sunday's game against the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Wydett Williams Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Coach Mike LaFleur has ruled out Williams (concussion) for Sunday's game against the Rams, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

injury_reports.name: Andrew Wingard
injury_reports.summary: Wingard (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Rams, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Gillikin
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Chad Ryland
injury_reports.summary: Ryland made all three of his extra-point attempts but missed his lone field-goal try during the Cardinals' 45-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: James Conner
injury_reports.summary: Conner (foot) is close to practicing, but the Cardinals aren't expected to open his 21-day evaluation window this week, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs have elevated Armstrong from the practice squad ahead of Sunday's game against the Chargers, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Noah Gray
injury_reports.summary: Gray caught two of his three targets for 17 yards in the Chiefs' 30-27 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Emmett Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson caught his lone target for 10 yards in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Travis Kelce
injury_reports.summary: Kelce caught two of four targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.name: Patrick Mahomes
injury_reports.summary: Mahomes completed 15 of 30 passes for 225 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders. He also rushed twice for no gain.

injury_reports.name: Rashee Rice
injury_reports.summary: Rice (hamstring/knee) will not play Sunday against the Chargers, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

injury_reports.name: Josh Simmons
injury_reports.summary: Simmons (back) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Kenneth Walker III

injury_reports.name: Justin Watson
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs elevated Watson from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Chargers, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Worthy
injury_reports.summary: Worthy will be the Chiefs' top wideout against the Chargers on Sunday due to the absence of Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee).

injury_reports.name: Nick Bolton
injury_reports.summary: Bolton posted nine tackles (four solo) during the Chiefs' 30-27 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Chamarri Conner
injury_reports.summary: Conner (knee) was a full participant at practice Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Mansoor Delane
injury_reports.summary: Delane tallied 10 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense during the Chiefs' 30-27 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: L'Jarius Sneed
injury_reports.summary: Sneed (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Butker
injury_reports.summary: Butker converted his only field-goal attempt and all three of his PATs during Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders.

injury_reports.summary: Alt (neck), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, received favorable news after recently being evaluated by a specialist and is expected to ramp up his activity during the Chargers' Week 7 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Kayode Awosika
injury_reports.summary: out

injury_reports.name: Omarion Hampton
injury_reports.summary: Hampton turned 14 carries into 33 yards and one target into a six-yard catch during Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Tre' Harris
injury_reports.summary: Harris (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Justin Herbert
injury_reports.summary: Herbert completed 14 of 24 passes for 121 yards, one touchdown and one interception, reeled off 54 yards on six carries and fumbled twice (one lost) during Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Quentin Johnston
injury_reports.summary: Johnston (chest) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Charlie Kolar
injury_reports.summary: Kolar reeled in three of four targets for 37 yards during Sunday's 23-17 loss versus the Broncos. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
injury_reports.summary: The Chargers activated Lambert-Smith (hamstring) from injured reserve Saturday, and he is questionable for Sunday's matchup versus Kansas City.

injury_reports.name: Ladd McConkey
injury_reports.summary: McConkey (foot) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Keaton Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: Mitchell took six carries for 11 yards and caught three of four targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 23-17 loss versus the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Brenen Thompson
injury_reports.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Kimani Vidal
injury_reports.summary: Vidal tallied eight carries for 57 yards and one touchdown, one catch (on two targets) for minus-1 yard and returned three kicks for 75 yards during Sunday's 23-17 defeat to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Jamaree Caldwell
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Daiyan Henley
injury_reports.summary: Henley (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Donte Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Derwin James Jr.
injury_reports.summary: James (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Rodney Shelley
injury_reports.summary: Shelley (hamstring) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

injury_reports.name: Dalvin Tomlinson
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Cameron Dicker
injury_reports.summary: Dicker made his lone field-goal attempt and both of his extra-point tries during the Chargers' 23-17 loss to the Broncos on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Alec Ingold
injury_reports.summary: The Chargers placed Ingold on injured reserve Thursday due to a shoulder injury.

injury_reports.name: Denzel Perryman
injury_reports.summary: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said Wednesday that Perryman (undisclosed) won't be reinstated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Jake Browning
injury_reports.summary: The Chargers signed Browning to the practice squad Tuesday, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Josh Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen completed 12 of 19 passes for 210 yards with one touchdown and one interception while adding 10 carries for 121 yards and another score and a two-point conversion pass in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win against the Rams on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Skyler Bell
injury_reports.summary: Bell will make his NFL regular-season debut against the Rams on Monday due to the absence of Joshua Palmer (shoulder), Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Keon Coleman
injury_reports.summary: Coleman caught a seven-yard touchdown pass on two targets during the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday.

injury_reports.name: James Cook III
injury_reports.summary: Cook rushed 10 times for 121 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for seven yards in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday night. He also committed two fumbles, losing one.

injury_reports.name: Ray Davis
injury_reports.summary: Davis caught his lone target for 31 yards while adding two carries for two yards and three kickoff returns for 114 yards during the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday.

injury_reports.name: Ty Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Dalton Kincaid
injury_reports.summary: Kincaid brought in one of two targets for seven yards and recorded a two-point conversion catch in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Dawson Knox
injury_reports.summary: Knox caught both of his targets for 13 yards in the Bills' 29-26 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: DJ Moore
injury_reports.summary: Moore (shoulder) will be listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Jay Skurski of The Buffalo News reports.

injury_reports.name: Joshua Palmer
injury_reports.summary: Palmer (shoulder) and DJ Moore (shoulder) are listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Khalil Shakir
injury_reports.summary: Shakir brought in all three targets for 80 yards in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Dee Alford
injury_reports.summary: Alford (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Christian Benford
injury_reports.summary: Benford (toe) does not carry an injury designation into Monday night's game against the Rams, Joe Buscaglia of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Te'Cory Couch
injury_reports.summary: Couch suffered a hamstring injury Sunday versus New England and is doubtful to return.

injury_reports.name: Mike Danna
injury_reports.summary: Danna re-signed with the Bills on Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Davison Igbinosun
injury_reports.summary: Even with Christian Benford (toe) back from injury, Igbinosun is still expected to have a role in the Bills' secondary for Monday's game against the Rams, Nick Suss of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Landon Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice.

injury_reports.name: Ed Oliver
injury_reports.summary: Oliver (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Las Vegas, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Greg Rousseau
injury_reports.summary: Rousseau logged four tackles (two solo) and two passes defensed in the Bills' 29-26 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Sanders
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Tyler Bass
injury_reports.summary: Bass went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made both of his PATs during Sunday's 29-26 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Aaron Banks
injury_reports.summary: Banks (knee/toe) is questionable for Sunday's game against Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Matthew Golden
injury_reports.summary: Golden secured six of seven targets for 123 yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Bears on Sunday. He also returned two punts for 27 yards.

injury_reports.name: Josh Jacobs
injury_reports.summary: Jacobs (personal) will be removed from the Commissioner's Exempt List on Monday and be eligible to play as soon as the Packers' Week 7 game at Detroit, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

injury_reports.name: Tucker Kraft
injury_reports.summary: Kraft brought in all five targets for 64 yards and rushed once for two yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Bears on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: MarShawn Lloyd
injury_reports.summary: Lloyd rushed 10 times for 31 yards and two touchdowns while catching one of two targets for six yards during Sunday's 31-7 win over the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Love
injury_reports.summary: Love completed 25 of 31 passes for 367 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding one carry for six yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Bears on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Monk
injury_reports.summary: Monk (quadriceps) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Coleman Owen
injury_reports.summary: The Packers elevated Owen from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Pierre Strong Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Strong took the field for 24 of the Packers' 59 offensive snaps in Sunday's 31-7 win over the Bears, finishing with five carries for seven yards and three catches for 11 yards on four targets.

injury_reports.name: Tyrod Taylor
injury_reports.summary: Taylor played the final two snaps of Sunday's 31-7 win over the Bears, losing two yards on a pair of kneeldowns.

injury_reports.name: Christian Watson
injury_reports.summary: Watson brought in six of eight targets for 143 yards and two touchdowns in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Bears on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Savion Williams
injury_reports.summary: The Packers activated Williams (ankle) from injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Campbell
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Brandon Cisse
injury_reports.summary: Cisse (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Keisean Nixon
injury_reports.summary: Nixon (groin) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Benjamin St-Juste
injury_reports.summary: St-Juste (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Evan Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams (illness) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Trey Smack
injury_reports.summary: Smack went 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts and 2-for-3 on extra-point tries during the Packers' 31-7 win over the Bears on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Ford
injury_reports.summary: The Packers placed Ford (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Javon Hargrave
injury_reports.summary: The Packers placed Hargrave (Achilles) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Skyy Moore
injury_reports.summary: The Packers placed Moore (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Micah Parsons
injury_reports.summary: The Packers aren't planning on opening Parsons' (knee) 21-day practice window this week ahead of Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Jordon Riley
injury_reports.summary: Riley (Achilles) had his 21-day practice window opened by the Packers on Wednesday, Mike Spofford of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.summary: Flournoy brought in three of four targets for 90 yards in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Buccaneers on Thursday night.

injury_reports.summary: Guyton (back) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: CeeDee Lamb

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Mingo

injury_reports.summary: With CeeDee Lamb (quadriceps) healthy and cleared to play Sunday night against the Packers, Pickens will handle his normal role as Dallas' WR2.

injury_reports.summary: Prescott completed 24 of 42 passes for 316 yards with a touchdown and two interceptions in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Buccaneers on Thursday night.

injury_reports.summary: Shelton (hamstring) has ben ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: KaVontae Turpin

injury_reports.name: Javonte Williams

injury_reports.name: Alijah Clark
injury_reports.summary: Clark (hamstring) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Downs
injury_reports.summary: Downs recorded four total tackles (two solo) during Thursday night's 24-16 loss to Tampa Bay.

injury_reports.name: Cobie Durant
injury_reports.summary: Durant (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Packers, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Malachi Lawrence
injury_reports.summary: Lawrence is expected to get more opportunities on the Cowboys' defense moving forward, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: DeMarvion Overshown

injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Dee Winters
injury_reports.summary: Winters registered 10 total tackles (six solo) during Thursday night's 24-16 loss to the Buccaneers.

injury_reports.name: Kaelon Black
injury_reports.summary: Black was excused from Saturday's practice to address a personal matter but does not have an injury designation for Monday's Week 6 matchup against Washington, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Mike Evans
injury_reports.summary: Evans (ribs) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Washington, Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Juszczyk
injury_reports.summary: Juszczyk (knee) was a full participant in Friday's practice, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

injury_reports.name: Christian Kirk
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Saturday that the 49ers may activate Kirk (calf) from injured reserve ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: George Kittle
injury_reports.summary: Kittle (illness) caught five of six targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 32-29 win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Thursday that the 49ers will "hold off" on placing Samuel (hamstring) on IR due to the team's bye in Week 8, Vic Tafur of the Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Nick Bosa
injury_reports.summary: Bosa (knee/calf) has been ruled out for Monday's Week 6 matchup against the Commanders, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

injury_reports.name: Renardo Green
injury_reports.summary: Green logged one solo tackle and three pass defenses (including two interceptions) during the 49ers' 32-29 win over the Seahawks on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dre Greenlaw
injury_reports.summary: Greenlaw's appeal of a one-game suspension was denied by the NFL on Tuesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
